message.subject: Re: Supply enquiry
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70270@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 13.1% (fc:320050@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70270.subject: Re: Supply enquiry
sup:70270.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70270@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 13.1% (fc:320050@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

# Packaging

email - 2025-12-11 - Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.

From November we deliver in returnable boxes instead of cardboard.

# Customer portfolio

meeting note - 2026-02-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

The sales director of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. said they are reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume.

# Visit by the owner

meeting note - 2026-03-18 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Visit by the owner of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.. He reminded us that in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-08-09 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o.: he asked where we get our index figures from - he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

# New contact person

email - 2025-10-09 - Metallbau Steinfelder KG

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-04-18 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Metallbau Steinfelder KG said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-07-21 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Metallbau Steinfelder KG: he offered to walk us through their calculation (hourly rates and material) if that helps to settle prices.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-07-28 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Metallbau Steinfelder KG: he asked where we get our index figures from - he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.

# Steel for 2027

letter - 2026-10-13 - Metallbau Steinfelder KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

for your planning: we have secured our steel sheet and coil for 2027, bought forward at fixed prices with our mill. Whatever the steel market does reaches our prices only from 2028.

Yours faithfully,
Metallbau Steinfelder KG

Kind regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Metallbau Steinfelder KG

# New contact person

email - 2025-10-14 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Trade fair invitation

email - 2025-11-09 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

We would be pleased to welcome you at our booth at the regional supplier fair in November.

# Payment of invoices

email - 2026-02-10 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-05-12 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Material purchasing

call note - 2026-06-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH: they bought their electricity forward until December 2028 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

call note - 2026-06-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH: they bought their electricity forward until December 2028 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

# New contact person

email - 2025-10-14 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Trade fair invitation

email - 2025-11-09 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

We would be pleased to welcome you at our booth at the regional supplier fair in November.

# Payment of invoices

email - 2026-02-10 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-05-12 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Material purchasing

call note - 2026-06-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH: they bought their electricity forward until December 2028 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

email - 2025-10-14 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Trade fair invitation

email - 2025-11-09 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

We would be pleased to welcome you at our booth at the regional supplier fair in November.

# Payment of invoices

email - 2026-02-10 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-05-12 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Material purchasing

call note - 2026-06-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH: they bought their electricity forward until December 2028 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

# New contact person

email - 2025-10-14 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

From 1 October your contact in sales is our new colleague in inside sales; all other contacts stay the same.

# Trade fair invitation

email - 2025-11-09 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

We would be pleased to welcome you at our booth at the regional supplier fair in November.

# Payment of invoices

email - 2026-02-10 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

# Supplier day

meeting note - 2026-05-12 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

At our supplier day Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o. said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.

# Material purchasing

call note - 2026-06-23 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH: they bought their electricity forward until December 2028 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

# Payment terms for stainless castings

letter - 2026-10-16 - Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

Dear Sir or Madam,

the start-up of our new moulding line has tied up more cash than we planned, and our bank is watching our figures closely. To keep alloy material flowing we kindly ask our customers to pay within 10 days from November. We are working hard on the porosity issue and will report on our corrective actions.

Yours faithfully,
Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH
